claim_text: San Javier is an independent municipality in central Sonora, founded 1706 as Real de Minas de San Javier
San Javier distance from Hermosillo ~146 km east; located in Sonora River watershed
San Javier civil records 1930–1934 split across multiple registries (Hermosillo, Villa Pesqueira, La Colorada)
San Javier has continuous silver-gold mining history from 1706 to present; silver 133–1240 g/ton; gold 0.41–7.07 g/ton
Mine Las Goteras (#16 in SGM inventory) has active concession held by Luis Porchas; located 6.74 km SE of San Javier parish church
28 of 32 San Javier mines listed under Ejido San Javier tenure — virtually all mining land expropriated post-Revolution
Francisco L. Terminel stripped of senatorial immunity (desafuero) on December 14 1935
